claims: The Artemis 2 mission will launch from Launch Complex 39B at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The crewed Orion spacecraft will lift off atop the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket from Launch Complex 39B at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center.
Launch Complex 39B at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center is used for Exploration Ground Systems.
Kennedy Space Center is located in Merritt Island, Florida.
Artemis 2 launch pad is Launch Complex 39B (LC-39B).
Artemis 2 mission type is 10-day crewed lunar flyby.
The Artemis 2 launch is aimed at testing deep space capabilities.
Viewing opportunities for the public are available along Florida's Space Coast for the Artemis 2 launch.
